_comment: The canonical id list for this org. refresh-metrics.sh reads ids from here and never re-derives them from the catalog, so a marketplace rename cannot silently drop a row. Order is display order in the README.

plugins.name: Bazaar
plugins.pitch: The plugin marketplace itself, in the bar. Search 1,300+ listings, read a plugin's detail, copy its install command, without opening a browser.

plugins.name: Pit Wall
plugins.pitch: The Formula 1 race weekend on the bar. Countdown to the next session, live timing during one, and the pill goes quiet between race weekends.

plugins.name: Wait State
plugins.pitch: Linux PSI pressure stall information in the bar. Shows when the machine is stalled on IO, memory or CPU, which load average cannot tell you.

plugins.name: MLB Booth
plugins.pitch: Live baseball on the bar. Score, half inning, base state and count for the game you follow, collapsing to nothing on an off day.

plugins.name: X Files
plugins.pitch: The replies to your own X posts, read from the desktop. A drainable queue so a conversation does not get lost in the feed.

plugins.name: Docket
plugins.pitch: The GitHub pull requests actually waiting on you, as a queue. Review requests and your own PRs with a changed state, not a notification firehose.

plugins.name: Crew Chief
plugins.pitch: Which of your AI coding agent sessions is blocked on you. Reads session state across running agents so a waiting prompt does not sit unseen.

plugins.name: Listening Post
plugins.pitch: A curated AI vendor release radar. Model releases, pricing changes and status incidents from 29 sources, in four lanes, quiet when nothing shipped.

template.pitch: The skeleton every entry above is built from. BarWidget, Panel, a node-testable Model.js, the nine-gate pre-submit lane and CI, so a new widget starts already passing.
